title: Battle effect
description: effect/<move>/effect.yaml: one slot of the battle effect file, written by dwx extract (apps/dwx/src/effect_extractors.cpp). Offsets in the header count from the slot's payload, as in script.yaml.

slot.description: Index of the slot in the file; the move with that index uses it.

move.description: Id of the move in data/moves, or null when the extraction had no tables.

effect_id.description: The id the slot stores; the original loads the slot only when it is 0x100 plus the slot.

loads.description: Whether the original loads the slot: false when effect_id is not the one it asks for.

texture.description: The slot's TIM as a PNG in this folder, with its _meta.yaml.

model.description: The slot's TMD as a GLB in this folder; only slots with a TMD have it.
